definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Paired plates that form the haemal arch. The lateral margin of each lamina is firmly attached to the ventral surface of the caudal vertebral centrum and the medial end fuses to the medial end of the opposite lamina.
description_en: Paired plates that form the haemal arch. The lateral margin of each lamina is firmly attached to the ventral surface of the caudal vertebral centrum and the medial end fuses to the medial end of the opposite lamina.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Anterior portion of the palate consisting of bone and mucous membranes [GO]. The hard palate is formed from bony processes of the maxilla, premaxilla and palatine bone [Kardong].
description_en: Anterior portion of the palate consisting of bone and mucous membranes [GO]. The hard palate is formed from bony processes of the maxilla, premaxilla and palatine bone [Kardong].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Haversian canals: lamellar channels in compact bone carrying vessels and nerves and linked to osteocytes in lacunae by canaliculi.
description_en: Haversian canals: lamellar channels in compact bone carrying vessels and nerves and linked to osteocytes in lacunae by canaliculi.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bone that is part of a head [Automatically generated definition].
description_en: A bone that is part of a head [Automatically generated definition].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Mesenchymal cells derived from neural crest cells that contribute to development of the hard and soft tissue in the head and neck, including the branchial arches[MP].
description_en: Mesenchymal cells derived from neural crest cells that contribute to development of the hard and soft tissue in the head and neck, including the branchial arches[MP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Teleost head kidney consists of fused bilateral lobes located in the anterior part of the kidney. It is analogous to the mammalian bone marrow and the primary site of definitive hematopoiesis[ZFA,modified].
description_en: Teleost head kidney consists of fused bilateral lobes located in the anterior part of the kidney. It is analogous to the mammalian bone marrow and the primary site of definitive hematopoiesis[ZFA,modified].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Portion of primordial embryonic connective tissue of the developing head, consisting of mesenchymal cells supported in interlaminar jelly, that derive mostly from the mesoderm and contribute to head connective tissue, bone and musculature in conjunction with cranial neural crest cells.
description_en: Portion of primordial embryonic connective tissue of the developing head, consisting of mesenchymal cells supported in interlaminar jelly, that derive mostly from the mesoderm and contribute to head connective tissue, bone and musculature in conjunction with cranial neural crest cells.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The hemispheric articular surface at the upper extremity of the thigh bone[Stedman, 26th ed]. The femur head is the highest part of the thigh bone. It is supported by the neck of the femur. The head is globular and forms rather more than a hemisphere, is directed upward, medialward, and a little forward, the greater part of its convexity being above and in front. Its surface is smooth, coated with cartilage in the fresh state, except over an ovoid depression, the fovea capitis femoris, which is situated a little below and behind the center of the head, and gives attachment to the ligament of head of femur. If there is a fracture of the neck of the femur, the blood supply through the ligament becomes crucial. In orthopedic surgery, the head of the femur is important because it can undergo avascular necrosis and consequent osteochondritis dissecans. The head is removed in total hip replacement surgery [WP].
description_en: The hemispheric articular surface at the upper extremity of the thigh bone[Stedman, 26th ed]. The femur head is the highest part of the thigh bone. It is supported by the neck of the femur. The head is globular and forms rather more than a hemisphere, is directed upward, medialward, and a little forward, the greater part of its convexity being above and in front. Its surface is smooth, coated with cartilage in the fresh state, except over an ovoid depression, the fovea capitis femoris, which is situated a little below and behind the center of the head, and gives attachment to the ligament of head of femur. If there is a fracture of the neck of the femur, the blood supply through the ligament becomes crucial. In orthopedic surgery, the head of the femur is important because it can undergo avascular necrosis and consequent osteochondritis dissecans. The head is removed in total hip replacement surgery [WP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The head of the rib is the end of a rib closest to the vertebral column, with which it articulates with.
description_en: The head of the rib is the end of a rib closest to the vertebral column, with which it articulates with.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A vertebral arch that is attached to the ventral surface or the vertebral centrum and encloses and protects the caudal artery and vein ventrally.
description_en: A vertebral arch that is attached to the ventral surface or the vertebral centrum and encloses and protects the caudal artery and vein ventrally.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Paired, ventromedially directed processes on the posterior ends of the centra, ligamentously joined to the hemal postzygapophyses of the immediately posterior vertebra. The most posterior caudal vertebrae lack hemal postzygapophyses.
description_en: Paired, ventromedially directed processes on the posterior ends of the centra, ligamentously joined to the hemal postzygapophyses of the immediately posterior vertebra. The most posterior caudal vertebrae lack hemal postzygapophyses.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hemal prezygapophyses are paired, anteromedially directed processes arising from the bases of hemal arches, ligamentously joined to the hemal postzygapophyses of the preceding vertebra. Posterior caudal vertebrae close to the caudal fin lack hemal prezygopophyses.
description_en: Hemal prezygapophyses are paired, anteromedially directed processes arising from the bases of hemal arches, ligamentously joined to the hemal postzygapophyses of the preceding vertebra. Posterior caudal vertebrae close to the caudal fin lack hemal prezygopophyses.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The hemiazygos vein (vena azygos minor inferior) is a vein running superiorly in the lower thoracic region, just to the left side of the vertebral column.
description_en: The hemiazygos vein (vena azygos minor inferior) is a vein running superiorly in the lower thoracic region, just to the left side of the vertebral column.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A venule that branches from the hepatic portal vein to transport nutrient-rich blood from the gastrointestinal tract and spleen to supply the liver. The hepatic portal venule is tributary of the hepatic sinusoids.
description_en: A venule that branches from the hepatic portal vein to transport nutrient-rich blood from the gastrointestinal tract and spleen to supply the liver. The hepatic portal venule is tributary of the hepatic sinusoids.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Type of tail (caudal) fin in which the vertebral column turns upwards into the upper lobe which is longer than the lower. Asymmetrical externally as well as internally.
description_en: Type of tail (caudal) fin in which the vertebral column turns upwards into the upper lobe which is longer than the lower. Asymmetrical externally as well as internally.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Vertebral centrum that bears saddle-shaped articular surfaces at both ends, having a convexity in the right-left axis and a concavity in the dorsoventral axis. This morphology allows great lateral and vertical flexion.
description_en: Vertebral centrum that bears saddle-shaped articular surfaces at both ends, having a convexity in the right-left axis and a concavity in the dorsoventral axis. This morphology allows great lateral and vertical flexion.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bone that is part of a hindlimb region. Examples: any pes phalanx, femur. Counter-examples: ischium, pubis (they are part of the pelvic girdle).
description_en: A bone that is part of a hindlimb region. Examples: any pes phalanx, femur. Counter-examples: ischium, pubis (they are part of the pelvic girdle).

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a hindlimb bone.
description_en: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a hindlimb bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A hindlimb bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
description_en: A hindlimb bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The space between the bones of the tibia and the fibula.
description_en: The space between the bones of the tibia and the fibula.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A proximal tarsal bone that articulates with the fibula.
description_en: A proximal tarsal bone that articulates with the fibula.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A long bone that is part of a hindlimb [Automatically generated definition].
description_en: A long bone that is part of a hindlimb [Automatically generated definition].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a hindlimb bone.
description_en: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a hindlimb bone.

english: bone of hind limb middle limb segment
translation_uz: bone of hind limb middle limb segment (Suyak)
definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bone that is part of a lower leg [Automatically generated definition].
description_en: A bone that is part of a lower leg [Automatically generated definition].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The hip region is located lateral to the gluteal region (i.e. the buttock), inferior to the iliac crest, and overlying the greater trochanter of the thigh bone. In adults, three of the bones of the pelvis have fused into the hip bone which forms part of the hip region. The hip joint, scientifically referred to as the acetabulofemoral joint (art. coxae), is the joint between the femur and acetabulum of the pelvis and its primary function is to support the weight of the body in both static (e.g. standing) and dynamic (e.g. walking or running) postures. [WP,modified].
description_en: The hip region is located lateral to the gluteal region (i.e. the buttock), inferior to the iliac crest, and overlying the greater trochanter of the thigh bone. In adults, three of the bones of the pelvis have fused into the hip bone which forms part of the hip region. The hip joint, scientifically referred to as the acetabulofemoral joint (art. coxae), is the joint between the femur and acetabulum of the pelvis and its primary function is to support the weight of the body in both static (e.g. standing) and dynamic (e.g. walking or running) postures. [WP,modified].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A synovial joint that connects the femur to the acetbulum of the innominate bone.
description_en: A synovial joint that connects the femur to the acetbulum of the innominate bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Spool-shaped vertebral centrum with a solid center. All traces of the notochord dissapear.
description_en: Spool-shaped vertebral centrum with a solid center. All traces of the notochord dissapear.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Type of tail fin in which the vertebrae generally turn upward at the hind end of the column, but which is externally symmetrical. The fin rays of the caudal are supported by hypaxial elements.
description_en: Type of tail fin in which the vertebrae generally turn upward at the hind end of the column, but which is externally symmetrical. The fin rays of the caudal are supported by hypaxial elements.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A craniometric point at the junction of the posterior midline border of the vomer with the sphenoid bone on the sphenovomerine suture.
description_en: A craniometric point at the junction of the posterior midline border of the vomer with the sphenoid bone on the sphenovomerine suture.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A pointed projection of the skin on the head of various animals, consisting of a covering of horn (keratin and other proteins) surrounding a core of living bone.
description_en: A pointed projection of the skin on the head of various animals, consisting of a covering of horn (keratin and other proteins) surrounding a core of living bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Humeroulnar joint: hinge articulation of the trochlear notch with the humeral trochlea, allowing flexion and extension at the elbow.
description_en: Humeroulnar joint: hinge articulation of the trochlear notch with the humeral trochlea, allowing flexion and extension at the elbow.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Ligament that links the tip of the postcleithral process of the cleithrum with either the vertebral column (at the vertebral parapophysis or rib of the sixth vertebra) or with the soft tissue around the postcleithral region.
description_en: Ligament that links the tip of the postcleithral process of the cleithrum with either the vertebral column (at the vertebral parapophysis or rib of the sixth vertebra) or with the soft tissue around the postcleithral region.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The bone of the upper arm, the humerus connects the shoulder to the elbow and provides the attachment points for muscles of the shoulder and arm that enable a wide range of upper limb movement. Proximally it articulates with the scapula at the glenohumeral joint, and distally with the radius and ulna at the elbow. Its surface landmarks include the greater and lesser tubercles, the deltoid tuberosity, and the medial and lateral epicondyles. Fractures of the surgical neck are common in elderly patients, while midshaft fractures may damage the radial nerve and cause wrist drop. In children, supracondylar fractures are the most common fractures at the elbow.
description_en: The bone of the upper arm, the humerus connects the shoulder to the elbow and provides the attachment points for muscles of the shoulder and arm that enable a wide range of upper limb movement. Proximally it articulates with the scapula at the glenohumeral joint, and distally with the radius and ulna at the elbow. Its surface landmarks include the greater and lesser tubercles, the deltoid tuberosity, and the medial and lateral epicondyles. Fractures of the surgical neck are common in elderly patients, while midshaft fractures may damage the radial nerve and cause wrist drop. In children, supracondylar fractures are the most common fractures at the elbow.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A humerus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
description_en: A humerus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): An elastic band connecting the anterior surface of the epiglottis to the upper border of the body of the hyoid bone.
description_en: An elastic band connecting the anterior surface of the epiglottis to the upper border of the body of the hyoid bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A muscle that attaches to the hyopid bone and to the tongue and is innervated by cranial nerve XII.
description_en: A muscle that attaches to the hyopid bone and to the tongue and is innervated by cranial nerve XII.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A group of bones comprised of hyoid body and two pairs of cornua (i.e. greater cornua and lesser cornua), and lies just below the tongue, above the thyroid cartilage.
description_en: A group of bones comprised of hyoid body and two pairs of cornua (i.e. greater cornua and lesser cornua), and lies just below the tongue, above the thyroid cartilage.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A horseshoe shaped bone situated in the anterior midline of the neck between the chin and the thyroid cartilage. The hyoid bone provides attachment to the muscles of the floor of the mouth and the tongue above, the larynx below, and the epiglottis and pharynx behind. [WP,modified].
description_en: A horseshoe shaped bone situated in the anterior midline of the neck between the chin and the thyroid cartilage. The hyoid bone provides attachment to the muscles of the floor of the mouth and the tongue above, the larynx below, and the epiglottis and pharynx behind. [WP,modified].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The main curve of the hyoid bone, from which the horns extend.
description_en: The main curve of the hyoid bone, from which the horns extend.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The larger and more lateral of the paired processes on either side of the hyoid bone[MP].
description_en: The larger and more lateral of the paired processes on either side of the hyoid bone[MP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Shorter and more medial of the paired processes on either side of the hyoid bone[MP].
description_en: Shorter and more medial of the paired processes on either side of the hyoid bone[MP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): One of a group of muscles used in mastication and swallowing. These muscles are attached to the hyoid bone, which is suspended in the neck and forms the base of the tongue and larynx. The muscles are divided into suprahyoid (superior) or infrahyoid (inferior) groups relative to the bone[WP, generalized].
description_en: One of a group of muscles used in mastication and swallowing. These muscles are attached to the hyoid bone, which is suspended in the neck and forms the base of the tongue and larynx. The muscles are divided into suprahyoid (superior) or infrahyoid (inferior) groups relative to the bone[WP, generalized].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Azygous or paired bone that occurs on the ventral surface of the hyoid plate.
description_en: Azygous or paired bone that occurs on the ventral surface of the hyoid plate.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint that articulates the hyomandibula bone and metapterygoid bone.
description_en: Joint that articulates the hyomandibula bone and metapterygoid bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and (in teleosts) articulates with the neurocranium dorsally and the opercle posteriorly[TAO,modified].
description_en: Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and (in teleosts) articulates with the neurocranium dorsally and the opercle posteriorly[TAO,modified].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Process on the dorso-posterior margin of the hyomandibula cartilage or bone that articulates with a depression on the antero-dorsal margin of the opercle.
description_en: Process on the dorso-posterior margin of the hyomandibula cartilage or bone that articulates with a depression on the antero-dorsal margin of the opercle.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The upper paired deep bone or cartilage of the hyoid region, sometimes taking part in jaw suspension and which supports the opercle. Dorsally it articulates with the otic capsule at the hyomandibular fossa, ventrally with the quadrate and symplectic. In most Teleostei it has a foramen for the hyomandibular branch of the facial nerve (VII).
description_en: The upper paired deep bone or cartilage of the hyoid region, sometimes taking part in jaw suspension and which supports the opercle. Dorsally it articulates with the otic capsule at the hyomandibular fossa, ventrally with the quadrate and symplectic. In most Teleostei it has a foramen for the hyomandibular branch of the facial nerve (VII).

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint that articulates the hyomandibular cartilage or bone and otic region cartilage or sphenotic bone, and often pterotic bone and prootic bone. Hyomandibular-otic region joint is paired.
description_en: Joint that articulates the hyomandibular cartilage or bone and otic region cartilage or sphenotic bone, and often pterotic bone and prootic bone. Hyomandibular-otic region joint is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Musculature that is derived from the hypaxial myotome region, trunk muscles that lie ventral to the horizontal septum of the vertebrae. Hypaxial muscles include some vertebral muscles, the diaphragm, the abdominal muscles, and all limb muscles.
description_en: Musculature that is derived from the hypaxial myotome region, trunk muscles that lie ventral to the horizontal septum of the vertebrae. Hypaxial muscles include some vertebral muscles, the diaphragm, the abdominal muscles, and all limb muscles.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 1 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 1 cartilage.
description_en: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 1 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 1 cartilage.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): hypobranchial 1 bone lateral cartilage
description_en: hypobranchial 1 bone lateral cartilage

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone.
description_en: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 2 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 2 cartilage.
description_en: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 2 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 2 cartilage.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): hypobranchial 2 bone lateral cartilage
description_en: hypobranchial 2 bone lateral cartilage

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone.
description_en: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 3 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 3 cartilage.
description_en: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 3 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 3 cartilage.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone.
description_en: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 4 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 4 cartilage.
description_en: Hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 4 element laterally. Develops in hypobranchial 4 cartilage.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.
description_en: Hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.
description_en: Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.
description_en: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Type of tail fin where the lower lobe is the longer and is supported by the vertebral column. Asymmetrical externally as well as internally.
description_en: Type of tail fin where the lower lobe is the longer and is supported by the vertebral column. Asymmetrical externally as well as internally.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Zone of bone organ located on the flat ventral side of the distal region of the furcula, serving as attachment region for pectoral muscles.
description_en: Zone of bone organ located on the flat ventral side of the distal region of the furcula, serving as attachment region for pectoral muscles.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Lowermost layer of the integumentary system in vertebrates. Types of cells that are found in the hypodermis are fibroblasts, adipose cells, and macrophages. It is derived from the mesoderm, but unlike the dermis, it is not derived from the dermatome region of the mesoderm. The hypodermis is used mainly for fat storage[WP].
description_en: Lowermost layer of the integumentary system in vertebrates. Types of cells that are found in the hypodermis are fibroblasts, adipose cells, and macrophages. It is derived from the mesoderm, but unlike the dermis, it is not derived from the dermatome region of the mesoderm. The hypodermis is used mainly for fat storage[WP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The hypoglossal canal is a bony canal in the occipital bone of the skull.
description_en: The hypoglossal canal is a bony canal in the occipital bone of the skull.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bony element (hypohyal bone) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.
description_en: A bony element (hypohyal bone) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Dermal bone bearing teeth located between the distal end of the premaxilla and the middle of the maxilla. The hypomaxilla is a paired bone.
description_en: Dermal bone bearing teeth located between the distal end of the premaxilla and the middle of the maxilla. The hypomaxilla is a paired bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Forms around the developing pituitary, and together with prechordal cartilages creates body of sphenoid bone.
description_en: Forms around the developing pituitary, and together with prechordal cartilages creates body of sphenoid bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A vein that is tributary of the cavernous sinus and drains blood from the pituitary gland.
description_en: A vein that is tributary of the cavernous sinus and drains blood from the pituitary gland.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Laterally flattened haemal spine of an ural vertebra that lacks its arch and supports a few principal caudal lepidotrichia distally. A hypural may articulate or fuse with its ural centrum proximally or may lie ventral to the notochord. A hypural is an unpaired median bone that ossifies perichondrally. (Modified from Monod, 1968 and Arratia and Schultze, 1992).
description_en: Laterally flattened haemal spine of an ural vertebra that lacks its arch and supports a few principal caudal lepidotrichia distally. A hypural may articulate or fuse with its ural centrum proximally or may lie ventral to the notochord. A hypural is an unpaired median bone that ossifies perichondrally. (Modified from Monod, 1968 and Arratia and Schultze, 1992).

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Perichondrally ossified bone that results from the fusion of two or more hypurals and support a variable number of principal caudal lepidotrichia. The hypural plate is an unpaired median bone.
description_en: Perichondrally ossified bone that results from the fusion of two or more hypurals and support a variable number of principal caudal lepidotrichia. The hypural plate is an unpaired median bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Lateral process, spine-like or crest-like, at the lateral wall of the haemal arch of the parhypural that serves for insertion of the hypochordal longitudinal muscle. The process may contribute to the lateral protection of the parhypural foramen (where the caudal blood vessels exit the hemal arch) and the hypural foramen (where a caudal heart may be present). The hypurapophysis is paired.
description_en: Lateral process, spine-like or crest-like, at the lateral wall of the haemal arch of the parhypural that serves for insertion of the hypochordal longitudinal muscle. The process may contribute to the lateral protection of the parhypural foramen (where the caudal blood vessels exit the hemal arch) and the hypural foramen (where a caudal heart may be present). The hypurapophysis is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The extension of the ilium above the level of the acetabulum. Attachment site for both hindlimb and caudal musculature. Medially is the site of attachment of the sacral ribs, where these exist[PHENOSCAPE:ad].
description_en: The extension of the ilium above the level of the acetabulum. Attachment site for both hindlimb and caudal musculature. Medially is the site of attachment of the sacral ribs, where these exist[PHENOSCAPE:ad].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): An iliac bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
description_en: An iliac bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bone spine that is part of a ilium.
description_en: A bone spine that is part of a ilium.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A muscle that attaches to the iliac crest and to a caudal vertebra.
description_en: A muscle that attaches to the iliac crest and to a caudal vertebra.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The iliocostalis cervicis (cervicalis ascendens) arises from the angles of the third, fourth, fifth, and sixth ribs, and is inserted into the posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of the fourth, fifth, and sixth cervical vertebrae..
description_en: The iliocostalis cervicis (cervicalis ascendens) arises from the angles of the third, fourth, fifth, and sixth ribs, and is inserted into the posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of the fourth, fifth, and sixth cervical vertebrae..

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The iliocostalis lumborum (iliocostalis muscle; sacrolumbalis muscle) is inserted, by six or seven flattened tendons, into the inferior borders of the angles of the lower six or seven ribs.
description_en: The iliocostalis lumborum (iliocostalis muscle; sacrolumbalis muscle) is inserted, by six or seven flattened tendons, into the inferior borders of the angles of the lower six or seven ribs.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The iliocostalis dorsi (musculus accessorius; iliocostalis thoracis) arises by flattened tendons from the upper borders of the angles of the lower six ribs medial to the tendons of insertion of the iliocostalis lumborum; these become muscular, and are inserted into the upper borders of the angles of the upper six ribs and into the back of the transverse process of the seventh cervical vertebra.
description_en: The iliocostalis dorsi (musculus accessorius; iliocostalis thoracis) arises by flattened tendons from the upper borders of the angles of the lower six ribs medial to the tendons of insertion of the iliocostalis lumborum; these become muscular, and are inserted into the upper borders of the angles of the upper six ribs and into the back of the transverse process of the seventh cervical vertebra.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The iliolumbar vein is the vena comitans of the iliolumbar artery. The obturator nerve crosses superficial to it. A single vein is found more commonly than a double vein. It drains vertebral segments four and five. It is closely related to the ascending lumbar vein. [WP,unvetted].
description_en: The iliolumbar vein is the vena comitans of the iliolumbar artery. The obturator nerve crosses superficial to it. A single vein is found more commonly than a double vein. It drains vertebral segments four and five. It is closely related to the ascending lumbar vein. [WP,unvetted].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Paired endochondral bone that is the dorsal-most of the pelvic bones, offering attachment areas for gluteal muscles on its main surface [PHENOSCAPE:ad].
description_en: Paired endochondral bone that is the dorsal-most of the pelvic bones, offering attachment areas for gluteal muscles on its main surface [PHENOSCAPE:ad].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The incus or anvil is the anvil-shaped small bone or ossicle in the middle ear. It connects the malleus to the stapes. It was first described by Alessandro Achillin of Bologna. The incus transmits sound vibrations from the malleus to the stapes. The incus only exists in mammals, and is derived from a reptilian upper jaw bone, the quadrate bone. Embryologically it is derived from the first pharyngeal arch along with the rest of the bones of mastication, such as the maxilla and mandible. [WP,unvetted].
description_en: The incus or anvil is the anvil-shaped small bone or ossicle in the middle ear. It connects the malleus to the stapes. It was first described by Alessandro Achillin of Bologna. The incus transmits sound vibrations from the malleus to the stapes. The incus only exists in mammals, and is derived from a reptilian upper jaw bone, the quadrate bone. Embryologically it is derived from the first pharyngeal arch along with the rest of the bones of mastication, such as the maxilla and mandible. [WP,unvetted].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): An incus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
description_en: An incus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A vein that is tributary of the transverse sinus and drains blood from the adjacent cortical regions of the temporal lobe. The inferior anastomotic vein forms an anastomosis (connection) between the superficial middle cerebral vein anteriorly and the transverse sinus posteriorly.
description_en: A vein that is tributary of the transverse sinus and drains blood from the adjacent cortical regions of the temporal lobe. The inferior anastomotic vein forms an anastomosis (connection) between the superficial middle cerebral vein anteriorly and the transverse sinus posteriorly.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): angulus inferior (scapula)
description_en: angulus inferior (scapula)

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The inferior cervical ganglion is situated between the base of the transverse process of the last cervical vertebra and the neck of the first rib, on the medial side of the costocervical artery. Its form is irregular; it is larger in size than the middle cervical ganglion, and is frequently fused with the first thoracic ganglion. [WP,unvetted].
description_en: The inferior cervical ganglion is situated between the base of the transverse process of the last cervical vertebra and the neck of the first rib, on the medial side of the costocervical artery. Its form is irregular; it is larger in size than the middle cervical ganglion, and is frequently fused with the first thoracic ganglion. [WP,unvetted].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The lower group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the glossopharyngeal nerve[MP]. It is situated in a depression in the lower border of the petrous portion of the temporal bone[WP].
description_en: The lower group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the glossopharyngeal nerve[MP]. It is situated in a depression in the lower border of the petrous portion of the temporal bone[WP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): arteria mesenterica inferior
description_en: arteria mesenterica inferior

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): inferior mesenteric plexus
description_en: inferior mesenteric plexus

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A turbinal located on the maxilla bone.
description_en: A turbinal located on the maxilla bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The orbital fissure that is situated inferiorly between the greater wing of the sphenoid bone and the maxilla.
description_en: The orbital fissure that is situated inferiorly between the greater wing of the sphenoid bone and the maxilla.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): arteriae pancreaticoduodenales inferiores
description_en: arteriae pancreaticoduodenales inferiores

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Elongate cartilage that extends anteroventrally from the solum nasi to abut the ventral portion of the posterior aspect of the alary process of the premaxilla. It was first described by Wiedersheim in 1876.
description_en: Elongate cartilage that extends anteroventrally from the solum nasi to abut the ventral portion of the posterior aspect of the alary process of the premaxilla. It was first described by Wiedersheim in 1876.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A vein that is a tributary of the internal pudendal vein and drains the lower third of the rectum and anal canal.
description_en: A vein that is a tributary of the internal pudendal vein and drains the lower third of the rectum and anal canal.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A lymph node located in the area below the clavicle.
description_en: A lymph node located in the area below the clavicle.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The region below the clavicle.
description_en: The region below the clavicle.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The infrahyoid muscles are a group of four pairs of muscles in the anterior part of the neck. (The term infrahyoid refers to the region below to the hyoid bone in the neck. ) Collectively, they are referred to as the strap muscles, because the muscles are long and flat much like a strap.
description_en: The infrahyoid muscles are a group of four pairs of muscles in the anterior part of the neck. (The term infrahyoid refers to the region below to the hyoid bone in the neck. ) Collectively, they are referred to as the strap muscles, because the muscles are long and flat much like a strap.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Scute that is an elongated plate associated with a ligament running between posterior nuchal plate and rib on vertebra 6. Infranuchal scute is paired and develops from its associated ligament and sensory canal tubular ossicle.
description_en: Scute that is an elongated plate associated with a ligament running between posterior nuchal plate and rib on vertebra 6. Infranuchal scute is paired and develops from its associated ligament and sensory canal tubular ossicle.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Dermal bone that is located anterior, ventral or posterior to the eye. Infraorbital bones may or may not contain the infraorbital sensory canal. Infraorbital bones are numbered starting with the anteriormost element of the series.
description_en: Dermal bone that is located anterior, ventral or posterior to the eye. Infraorbital bones may or may not contain the infraorbital sensory canal. Infraorbital bones are numbered starting with the anteriormost element of the series.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Infraorbital in fishes that is the first (anteriormost) bone of the infraorbital series.
description_en: Infraorbital in fishes that is the first (anteriormost) bone of the infraorbital series.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Infraorbital that is the tenth bone of the infraorbital series.
description_en: Infraorbital that is the tenth bone of the infraorbital series.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Infraorbital that is the eleventh bone of the infraorbital series.

description_en: Infraorbital that is the fourth bone of the infraorbital series.

description_en: Infraorbital that is the fifth bone of the infraorbital series.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Infraorbital that is the ninth bone of the infraorbital series.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A ridge of bone connecting left and right orbital margins located beneath the eye sockets.
description_en: A ridge of bone connecting left and right orbital margins located beneath the eye sockets.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and supraorbital sensory canals at their union. The infraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the infraorbital bones.
description_en: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and supraorbital sensory canals at their union. The infraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the infraorbital bones.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Anatomical cluster that is the series of dermal bones surrounding the orbit and associated with the infraorbital sensory canal.
description_en: Anatomical cluster that is the series of dermal bones surrounding the orbit and associated with the infraorbital sensory canal.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The infrapatellar fat pad, also known as Hoffa's fat pad, is a cylindrical piece of fat that is situated under and behind the patella bone within the knee.
description_en: The infrapatellar fat pad, also known as Hoffa's fat pad, is a cylindrical piece of fat that is situated under and behind the patella bone within the knee.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Infratemporal fossa: irregular cavity below the zygomatic arch bounded by maxilla, sphenoid, and pterygoid plates, pierced by foramen ovale.
description_en: Infratemporal fossa: irregular cavity below the zygomatic arch bounded by maxilla, sphenoid, and pterygoid plates, pierced by foramen ovale.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A band running from the pubic tubercle to the anterior superior iliac spine. Its anatomy is very important for operating on hernia patients. It forms the base of the inguinal canal through which an indirect inguinal hernia may develop. The inguinal ligament runs from the anterior superior iliac spine of the ilium to the pubic tubercle of the pubic bone. It is formed by the external abdominal oblique aponeurosis and is continuous with the fascia lata of the thigh.
description_en: A band running from the pubic tubercle to the anterior superior iliac spine. Its anatomy is very important for operating on hernia patients. It forms the base of the inguinal canal through which an indirect inguinal hernia may develop. The inguinal ligament runs from the anterior superior iliac spine of the ilium to the pubic tubercle of the pubic bone. It is formed by the external abdominal oblique aponeurosis and is continuous with the fascia lata of the thigh.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The skin covering the inguinal region between the abdomen and the thigh on either side of the pubic bone.
description_en: The skin covering the inguinal region between the abdomen and the thigh on either side of the pubic bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A fused bone consisting of the ilium, ischium and pubis. Together with the sacrum and coccyx, it comprises the pelvis. [WP,modified].
description_en: A fused bone consisting of the ilium, ischium and pubis. Together with the sacrum and coccyx, it comprises the pelvis. [WP,modified].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Three pairs of cartilaginous elements posterior to the sternum that lie in the myosepta of the ventral trunk musculature.
description_en: Three pairs of cartilaginous elements posterior to the sternum that lie in the myosepta of the ventral trunk musculature.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Posterior portion of the eye-antennal disc. It gives rise to the adult antennal segments and the maxillary palp, as well as contributing to the head capsule.
description_en: Posterior portion of the eye-antennal disc. It gives rise to the adult antennal segments and the maxillary palp, as well as contributing to the head capsule.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Connected anatomical system that forms a barrier between an animal and its environment. In vertebrates, the integumental system consists of the epidermis, dermis plus associated glands and adnexa such as hair and scales. In invertebrates, the integumental system may include cuticle.
description_en: Connected anatomical system that forms a barrier between an animal and its environment. In vertebrates, the integumental system consists of the epidermis, dermis plus associated glands and adnexa such as hair and scales. In invertebrates, the integumental system may include cuticle.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Pharyngeal arch bone located between uncinate process of epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2.
description_en: Pharyngeal arch bone located between uncinate process of epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint that articulates the left and right basipterygium cartilage or bone. Inter-basipterygium joint is unpaired.
description_en: Joint that articulates the left and right basipterygium cartilage or bone. Inter-basipterygium joint is unpaired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Small membrane bone homologous with a cartilage bone in more basal fishes (Patterson, 1977). Situated between the exoccipital and the pterotic at point of attachment of short ligament that originates on the ventral arm of the posttemporal.
description_en: Small membrane bone homologous with a cartilage bone in more basal fishes (Patterson, 1977). Situated between the exoccipital and the pterotic at point of attachment of short ligament that originates on the ventral arm of the posttemporal.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Neural arch and Weberian ossicle that has been modified in shape relative to other neural arches. Intercalarium includes three parts: an anterolateral process (the manubrium) which is embedded in the interossicular ligament and the ascending and articulating processes.
description_en: Neural arch and Weberian ossicle that has been modified in shape relative to other neural arches. Intercalarium includes three parts: an anterolateral process (the manubrium) which is embedded in the interossicular ligament and the ascending and articulating processes.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): intercalated amygdalar nuclei
description_en: intercalated amygdalar nuclei

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A skeletal joint that connects two carpal bones.
description_en: A skeletal joint that connects two carpal bones.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): articulatio interchondralis
description_en: articulatio interchondralis

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Dermal bone of pectoral girdle that is median and ventral in position.
description_en: Dermal bone of pectoral girdle that is median and ventral in position.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint that articulates left and right clavicles.
description_en: Joint that articulates left and right clavicles.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint between the right and left coracoid bones of the pectoral girdle.
description_en: Joint between the right and left coracoid bones of the pectoral girdle.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): One of a group of arteries that supply the area between the ribs ('costae'), called the intercostal space.
description_en: One of a group of arteries that supply the area between the ribs ('costae'), called the intercostal space.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Ligament that connects one rib to another.
description_en: Ligament that connects one rib to another.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The respiratory muscles that arise from the lower border of one rib and insert into the upper border of the adjoining rib.
description_en: The respiratory muscles that arise from the lower border of one rib and insert into the upper border of the adjoining rib.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): anterior ramus of thoracic nerve
description_en: anterior ramus of thoracic nerve

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A space in the rib cage between two successive ribs.
description_en: A space in the rib cage between two successive ribs.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The intercostal veins are a group of veins which drain the area between the ribs.
description_en: The intercostal veins are a group of veins which drain the area between the ribs.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The intercuneiform articulations are articulations among the cuneiform bones[WP,unverified].
description_en: The intercuneiform articulations are articulations among the cuneiform bones[WP,unverified].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The interdental plate refers to the bone-filled mesial-distal region between the teeth.
description_en: The interdental plate refers to the bone-filled mesial-distal region between the teeth.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bone between the frontal bones in the skull; an extra bony plate within the anterior fontanelle that is not usually present.
description_en: A bone between the frontal bones in the skull; an extra bony plate within the anterior fontanelle that is not usually present.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint between the left and right frontal bone.
description_en: Joint between the left and right frontal bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A small bone articulating distally with the haemal arch or a short haemal spine.
description_en: A small bone articulating distally with the haemal arch or a short haemal spine.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.
description_en: Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint that articulates the interhyal and epihyal bones, or interhyal and ceratohyal cartilages. Interhyal-epihyal joint is paired.
description_en: Joint that articulates the interhyal and epihyal bones, or interhyal and ceratohyal cartilages. Interhyal-epihyal joint is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Joint that articulates the left and right hypobranchial 3 cartilages or bones. Inter-hypobranchial 3 joint is unpaired.
description_en: Joint that articulates the left and right hypobranchial 3 cartilages or bones. Inter-hypobranchial 3 joint is unpaired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Median palatine suture of the palatine processes of the maxillary bones, and the median suture of the palatine bones.
description_en: Median palatine suture of the palatine processes of the maxillary bones, and the median suture of the palatine bones.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A gland lodged in a fossa formed mainly of dermal bones, situated wholly in front of the nasal capsules of Osteolepiformes.
description_en: A gland lodged in a fossa formed mainly of dermal bones, situated wholly in front of the nasal capsules of Osteolepiformes.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The primordial mass of tissue formed by the merging of the medial nasal prominences of the embryo; it contributes to the intermaxillary portion of the upper jaw, the prolabial portion of the upper lip, and the primary palate.
description_en: The primordial mass of tissue formed by the merging of the medial nasal prominences of the embryo; it contributes to the intermaxillary portion of the upper jaw, the prolabial portion of the upper lip, and the primary palate.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A gland located at the pre-nasal area being divided anteriorly by the ascendent processes of the intermaxillary bone.
description_en: A gland located at the pre-nasal area being divided anteriorly by the ascendent processes of the intermaxillary bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A cranial suture in the midline of the skull that connects the left and right maxilla bones.
description_en: A cranial suture in the midline of the skull that connects the left and right maxilla bones.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Endochondral carpal bone articulating with the ulnare and the radiale.
description_en: Endochondral carpal bone articulating with the ulnare and the radiale.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Quadrangular cartilage or bone lying between the preaxial radiale and the postaxial ulnare in the proximal level of the mesopodium.
description_en: Quadrangular cartilage or bone lying between the preaxial radiale and the postaxial ulnare in the proximal level of the mesopodium.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Axial bone which is a segmental ossification that forms in the myoseptum.
description_en: Axial bone which is a segmental ossification that forms in the myoseptum.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The internal auditory meatus (also internal acoustic meatus, internal auditory canal, and internal acoustic canal) is a canal in the petrous bone of the temporal bone of the skull that carries nerves from inside the cranium towards the middle and inner ear compartments namely cranial nerve VII and cranial nerve VIII.
description_en: The internal auditory meatus (also internal acoustic meatus, internal auditory canal, and internal acoustic canal) is a canal in the petrous bone of the temporal bone of the skull that carries nerves from inside the cranium towards the middle and inner ear compartments namely cranial nerve VII and cranial nerve VIII.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The internal carotid plexus (carotid plexus) is situated on the lateral side of the internal carotid artery, and in the plexus there occasionally exists a small gangliform swelling, the carotid ganglion, on the under surface of the artery. Postganglionic sympathetic fibres ascend from the superior cervical ganglion, along the walls of the internal carotid artery, to enter the internal carotid plexus. These fibres then distribute to deep structures, which include the levator palpebrae superioris and pupillary dilator muscles. Some of the fibres from the internal carotid plexus converge to form the deep petrosal nerve. The internal carotid plexus communicates with the semilunar ganglion, the abducent nerve, and the sphenopalatine ganglion; it distributes filaments to the wall of the carotid artery, and also communicates with the tympanic branch of the glossopharyngeal nerve. [WP,unvetted].
description_en: The internal carotid plexus (carotid plexus) is situated on the lateral side of the internal carotid artery, and in the plexus there occasionally exists a small gangliform swelling, the carotid ganglion, on the under surface of the artery. Postganglionic sympathetic fibres ascend from the superior cervical ganglion, along the walls of the internal carotid artery, to enter the internal carotid plexus. These fibres then distribute to deep structures, which include the levator palpebrae superioris and pupillary dilator muscles. Some of the fibres from the internal carotid plexus converge to form the deep petrosal nerve. The internal carotid plexus communicates with the semilunar ganglion, the abducent nerve, and the sphenopalatine ganglion; it distributes filaments to the wall of the carotid artery, and also communicates with the tympanic branch of the glossopharyngeal nerve. [WP,unvetted].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The internal iliac lymph nodes (or hypogastric) surround the internal iliac artery and its branches (the hypogastric vessels), and receive the lymphatics corresponding to the distribution of the branches of it, i. e. , they receive lymphatics from all the pelvic viscera, from the deeper parts of the perineum, including the membranous and cavernous portions of the urethra, and from the buttock and back of the thigh. It does not receive lymph from the ovary, testis, or superior half of the rectum; the gonads drain to the paraaortic lymph nodes, while the superior half of the rectum drains to the pararectal lymph nodes.
description_en: The internal iliac lymph nodes (or hypogastric) surround the internal iliac artery and its branches (the hypogastric vessels), and receive the lymphatics corresponding to the distribution of the branches of it, i. e. , they receive lymphatics from all the pelvic viscera, from the deeper parts of the perineum, including the membranous and cavernous portions of the urethra, and from the buttock and back of the thigh. It does not receive lymph from the ovary, testis, or superior half of the rectum; the gonads drain to the paraaortic lymph nodes, while the superior half of the rectum drains to the pararectal lymph nodes.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bony element (internal surface of frontal bone) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.
description_en: A bony element (internal surface of frontal bone) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): An artery that supplies the anterior chest wall and the breasts. It is a paired artery, with one running along each side of the sternum, to continue after its bifurcation as the superior epigastric and musculophrenic arteries. [WP,unvetted].
description_en: An artery that supplies the anterior chest wall and the breasts. It is a paired artery, with one running along each side of the sternum, to continue after its bifurcation as the superior epigastric and musculophrenic arteries. [WP,unvetted].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A boney projection on the internal diaphysis of the femur anterior or medial to the intertrochanteric fossa, below the femoral head. Muscle attachment site for ventral muscle mass notably the puboischiofemoralis externus. Modified from Romer 1956.
description_en: A boney projection on the internal diaphysis of the femur anterior or medial to the intertrochanteric fossa, below the femoral head. Muscle attachment site for ventral muscle mass notably the puboischiofemoralis externus. Modified from Romer 1956.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A suture joining the nasal bones.
description_en: A suture joining the nasal bones.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, and located anterior to the anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plate.
description_en: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, and located anterior to the anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plate.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Dermal bone that is part of the opercular series. It is located ventro-medially to the preopercle and anterior to the subopercle. It is joined to the posterior part of the lower jaw (retroarticular) by a ligament. The interopercle is paired.
description_en: Dermal bone that is part of the opercular series. It is located ventro-medially to the preopercle and anterior to the subopercle. It is joined to the posterior part of the lower jaw (retroarticular) by a ligament. The interopercle is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Anatomical cluster composed of one or more bones and tissue that separates the orbits.
description_en: Anatomical cluster composed of one or more bones and tissue that separates the orbits.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Any of the muscles of the autopod region that lie between metacarpal or metatarsal bones.
description_en: Any of the muscles of the autopod region that lie between metacarpal or metatarsal bones.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The bone of the cranium that lies above and anterior to the occipital bone in some mammals.
description_en: The bone of the cranium that lies above and anterior to the occipital bone in some mammals.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bony element (interparietal bone primordium) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.
description_en: A bony element (interparietal bone primordium) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Fibrous joint connecting the parietal bones.
description_en: Fibrous joint connecting the parietal bones.

description_en: Joint that articulates the left and right premaxillary bones. Inter-premaxillary joint is unpaired.

description_en: The region on the palate corresponding to the location of the pterygoid bone, if present and between the palatine bones and the parasphenoid if not.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The small branching sprouts of the dorsal aorta that grow across the medial surface of the somite, turn right angles to grow over that surface and then fuse with other sprouts and form the vertebral arteries adjacent to the neural tube; the intersomitic arteries supply the body wall and persist in the adult as the posterior intercostal, subcostal and the lumbar arteries.

description_en: A suture joining the basisphenoid bone and the presphenoid bone of a sphenoid bone.

description_en: Sesamoid bone in the tarsal region.

description_en: Joint that articulates the contralateral ventral hypohyal bones or the contralateral ceratobranchial cartilages. Inter-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A cartilage element that lies between two successive vertebral centra.
description_en: A cartilage element that lies between two successive vertebral centra.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): An intervertebral disk that connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 3 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 4.
description_en: An intervertebral disk that connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 3 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 4.

In the thorax, it is tributary of the posterior intercostal veins. In the lumbar and sacral regions, it is tributary of the lumbar and lateral sacral veins

description_en: A venule that receives drainage from the capillary beds after blood has perfused the pulmonary alveoli, and is tributary of the pulmonary venules.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Intramembranous bone: tissue formed directly in mesenchyme by osteoblasts, without the cartilage model used in endochondral ossification.
description_en: Intramembranous bone: tissue formed directly in mesenchyme by osteoblasts, without the cartilage model used in endochondral ossification.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Bone tissue that forms directly within mesenchyme, and does not replace other tissues[TAO]. Intramembranous ossification is the formation of bone in which osteoblasts secrete a collagen-proteoglycan matrix that binds calcium salts and becomes calcified[GO]. Intramembranous ossification is the way flat bones and the shell of a turtle are formed[GO]. Unlike endochondral ossification, cartilage is not present during intramembranous ossification[WP].
description_en: Bone tissue that forms directly within mesenchyme, and does not replace other tissues[TAO]. Intramembranous ossification is the formation of bone in which osteoblasts secrete a collagen-proteoglycan matrix that binds calcium salts and becomes calcified[GO]. Intramembranous ossification is the way flat bones and the shell of a turtle are formed[GO]. Unlike endochondral ossification, cartilage is not present during intramembranous ossification[WP].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A bony element (intramembranous scleral ossicle) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.
description_en: A bony element (intramembranous scleral ossicle) that provides structural support and protection in the skeletal system.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Involucrum: the sheath of new periosteal bone laid down around infected cortex in pyogenic osteomyelitis after pus strips the periosteum.
description_en: Involucrum: the sheath of new periosteal bone laid down around infected cortex in pyogenic osteomyelitis after pus strips the periosteum.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The irregular bones are bones which, from their peculiar form, cannot be grouped as long bone, short bone, flat bone or sesamoid bone. Irregular bones serve various purposes in the body, such as protection of nervous tissue, affording multiple anchor points for skeletal muscle attachment (as with the sacrum), and maintaining pharynx and trachea support, and tongue attachment (such as the hyoid bone). They consist of cancellous tissue enclosed within a thin layer of compact bone. The irregular bones are: the vertebrC&, sacrum, coccyx, temporal, sphenoid, ethmoid, zygomatic, maxilla, mandible, palatine, inferior nasal concha, and hyoid.
description_en: The irregular bones are bones which, from their peculiar form, cannot be grouped as long bone, short bone, flat bone or sesamoid bone. Irregular bones serve various purposes in the body, such as protection of nervous tissue, affording multiple anchor points for skeletal muscle attachment (as with the sacrum), and maintaining pharynx and trachea support, and tongue attachment (such as the hyoid bone). They consist of cancellous tissue enclosed within a thin layer of compact bone. The irregular bones are: the vertebrC&, sacrum, coccyx, temporal, sphenoid, ethmoid, zygomatic, maxilla, mandible, palatine, inferior nasal concha, and hyoid.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): An ischial bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
description_en: An ischial bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Endochondral bone that is paired, forming the posterior part of the pelvis, articulating with the pubis and ilium.
description_en: Endochondral bone that is paired, forming the posterior part of the pelvis, articulating with the pubis and ilium.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Neuromast of the supraorbital sensory canal in the nasal bone. It is innervated by the buccal nerve rather than by the supraorbital nerve, which invariably innervates neuromasts of the supraorbital canal. (Johnson and Patterson 1993).
description_en: Neuromast of the supraorbital sensory canal in the nasal bone. It is innervated by the buccal nerve rather than by the supraorbital nerve, which invariably innervates neuromasts of the supraorbital canal. (Johnson and Patterson 1993).

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A tributary of the superior mesenteric vein that drains the jejunum.
description_en: A tributary of the superior mesenteric vein that drains the jejunum.

latin: joint connecting upper and lower jaws
definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Synovial joint that articulates bones of upper and lower jaw.
description_en: Synovial joint that articulates bones of upper and lower jaw.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Any synovial joint that connects auditory ossicles.
description_en: Any synovial joint that connects auditory ossicles.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Any joint that connects a rib to another structure (or another rib). Examples: costochondral, costovertebral, interchondral, sternocostal joints.
description_en: Any joint that connects a rib to another structure (or another rib). Examples: costochondral, costovertebral, interchondral, sternocostal joints.

description_en: synovial cavity of elbow joint

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The quadrilateral bone that forms the prominence of the cheek.
description_en: The quadrilateral bone that forms the prominence of the cheek.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Sesamoid bone located in the premaxillary-ethmoid ligament, between the mesethmoid and the premaxilla. The kinethmoid is an unpaired median bone.
description_en: Sesamoid bone located in the premaxillary-ethmoid ligament, between the mesethmoid and the premaxilla. The kinethmoid is an unpaired median bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The knee joint joins the thigh with the leg and consists of two articulations: one between the femur and tibia, and one between the femur and patella. It is the largest and most complicated joint in the human body. The knee is a mobile trocho-ginglymus (i.e. a pivotal hinge joint), which permits flexion and extension as well as a slight medial and lateral rotation[WP,unvetted].
description_en: The knee joint joins the thigh with the leg and consists of two articulations: one between the femur and tibia, and one between the femur and patella. It is the largest and most complicated joint in the human body. The knee is a mobile trocho-ginglymus (i.e. a pivotal hinge joint), which permits flexion and extension as well as a slight medial and lateral rotation[WP,unvetted].

latin: L1 segment of lumbar spinal cord
definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The segment of the spinal cord that corresponds to the first lumbar vertebra in most mammals.
description_en: The segment of the spinal cord that corresponds to the first lumbar vertebra in most mammals.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The segment of the spinal cord that corresponds to the second lumbar vertebra in most mammals.

description_en: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, facing the lips.[PHENOSCAPE:WD].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A long slender branch of the anterior inferior cerebellar artery (85%-100% cases) or basilar artery (<15% cases), arises from near the middle of the artery; it accompanies the vestibulocochlear nerve through the internal acoustic meatus, and is distributed to the internal ear.
description_en: A long slender branch of the anterior inferior cerebellar artery (85%-100% cases) or basilar artery (<15% cases), arises from near the middle of the artery; it accompanies the vestibulocochlear nerve through the internal acoustic meatus, and is distributed to the internal ear.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The irregularly thin plate that forms part of the medial wall of the orbit behind the frontal process of the maxilla.
description_en: The irregularly thin plate that forms part of the medial wall of the orbit behind the frontal process of the maxilla.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The upper dilated end of the nasolacrimal duct that is lodged in a deep groove formed by the lacrimal bone and frontal process of the maxilla; it connects the lacrimal canaliculi, which drain tears from the eye's surface, and the nasolacrimal duct, which conveys this fluid into the nasal cavity; like the nasolacrimal duct, the sac is lined by stratified columnar epithelium with mucus-secreting goblet cells, and is surrounded by connective tissue.
description_en: The upper dilated end of the nasolacrimal duct that is lodged in a deep groove formed by the lacrimal bone and frontal process of the maxilla; it connects the lacrimal canaliculi, which drain tears from the eye's surface, and the nasolacrimal duct, which conveys this fluid into the nasal cavity; like the nasolacrimal duct, the sac is lined by stratified columnar epithelium with mucus-secreting goblet cells, and is surrounded by connective tissue.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A suture between the lacrimal bone and the maxilla.
description_en: A suture between the lacrimal bone and the maxilla.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Anatomical cluster that consists of a bulla formed by the exoccipital and basioccipital bones, and surrounds the lagena.
description_en: Anatomical cluster that consists of a bulla formed by the exoccipital and basioccipital bones, and surrounds the lagena.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The dense, fibrous connective tissue joint between the parietal bones and the occipital bone.
description_en: The dense, fibrous connective tissue joint between the parietal bones and the occipital bone.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Bone tissue that has a regular parallel alignment of collagen into sheets (lamellae) and is mechanically strong.
description_en: Bone tissue that has a regular parallel alignment of collagen into sheets (lamellae) and is mechanically strong.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The osseous spiral lamina consists of two plates of bone, and between these are the canals for the transmission of the filaments of the acoustic nerve. On the upper plate of that part of the lamina which is outside the vestibular membrane, the periosteum is thickened to form the limbus spiralis (or limbus laminæ spiralis), this ends externally in a concavity, the sulcus spiralis internus, which represents, on section, the form of the letter C. [WP,unvetted].
description_en: The osseous spiral lamina consists of two plates of bone, and between these are the canals for the transmission of the filaments of the acoustic nerve. On the upper plate of that part of the lamina which is outside the vestibular membrane, the periosteum is thickened to form the limbus spiralis (or limbus laminæ spiralis), this ends externally in a concavity, the sulcus spiralis internus, which represents, on section, the form of the letter C. [WP,unvetted].

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Membrane bone extending between a transverse process of the second proximal dorsal-fin radial and the pleural rib of the sixth vertebra. Lateral bone is paired.
description_en: Membrane bone extending between a transverse process of the second proximal dorsal-fin radial and the pleural rib of the sixth vertebra. Lateral bone is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Region of the braincase which bears the facets for the hyomandibula in fishes. This region disappears in the origin of tetrapods and the space it occipied comes to contribute to the fenestra vestibulii. Clack, JA, 2001. Ch. 23, The otoccipital region. In Major Events in Early Vertebrate Evolution. Per Ahlberg editor.
description_en: Region of the braincase which bears the facets for the hyomandibula in fishes. This region disappears in the origin of tetrapods and the space it occipied comes to contribute to the fenestra vestibulii. Clack, JA, 2001. Ch. 23, The otoccipital region. In Major Events in Early Vertebrate Evolution. Per Ahlberg editor.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The lateral condyle of talus is an articular prominence of bone on the lateral side of the trochlea of a talus, which engages with the tibia.
description_en: The lateral condyle of talus is an articular prominence of bone on the lateral side of the trochlea of a talus, which engages with the tibia.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Endochondral bone that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. It may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. The lateral ethmoid is paired.
description_en: Endochondral bone that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. It may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. The lateral ethmoid is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Endochondral element that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. It may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. The lateral ethmoid is paired.
description_en: Endochondral element that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. It may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. The lateral ethmoid is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): The most lateral of the paired series of extrascapular bones and is the bone where the intersection of the otic, postotic and extrascapular or supratemporal canals occur.
description_en: The most lateral of the paired series of extrascapular bones and is the bone where the intersection of the otic, postotic and extrascapular or supratemporal canals occur.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): Fontanel within the frontal bone near the frontal-sphenotic joint. Lateral fontanel of frontal is paired.
description_en: Fontanel within the frontal bone near the frontal-sphenotic joint. Lateral fontanel of frontal is paired.

definition_uz: Anatomik ta'rif (Suyak): A distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the striatum; however, neocortex, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the LGE.
description_en: A distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the striatum; however, neocortex, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the LGE.
